<!-- A pull request's description opens with its text, not a heading. -->
<!-- markdownlint-disable-file MD041 -->
<!--
What this changes, and why. Link the issue or discussion it comes from: "Fixes #123".
CONTRIBUTING.md says how to build, test and write the commits.
-->

- [ ] Every commit follows
      [the commit-message format](https://github.com/oxidestack/docx-to-pdf/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages)
      and is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] A `feat`, `fix`, `perf` or breaking commit carries a `release-note` block.
- [ ] Tests show the change: a bug fix comes with the test that failed before it.
- [ ] The guide that documents a changed request, answer, setting, chart value or metric is updated.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
